# Overview

This report compares paired **Start** and **End** samples from each plant–tank
combination. Controls are included in quality control and the control-inclusive
ordination, then excluded from subsequent community analyses.


# Data preparation

```{r data-2, include=FALSE}

source(paste0(WD, "/scripts/tidy_long_function.R"))


input_files <- file.path(
  WD, "data/output",
  c("abund_table.tsv", "zOTUs.sintax", "totalreads.csv")
)
sample_data <- vroom::vroom(paste0(WD, "/data/sample_metadata.csv"))

# ASV based 
d_ASV_V4 <- amp_load(otutable = paste0(WD, "/data/output/abund_table.tsv"),
              taxonomy = paste0(WD, "/data/output/zOTUs.sintax"),
              metadata = sample_data
              ) 
# Total reads 
summary_reads_ASV <- read.csv(paste0(WD, "/data/output/totalreads.csv"), header = FALSE, col.names = c("Barcode", "total_reads")) 

merged_alpha_div <- d_ASV_V4 %>% amp_alpha_diversity() %>% mutate(sequence_unit = "ASV") %>%
      left_join(summary_reads_ASV, by = join_by(Barcode))

d_long <- d_ASV_V4 %>% 
  amp_subset_samples(SampleContent != "CTRL") %>% 
  tidy_midas_global(., SampleID_column_name = "SampleID") %>% 
  mutate(samples = map(.x = samples, ~group_by(.x, Family) %>%
                               mutate(rel_abun_family = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>%
                              ungroup())) %>% 
  mutate(samples = map(.x = samples, ~group_by(.x, Order) %>%
                               mutate(rel_abun_order = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>%
                              ungroup())) %>% 
  mutate(samples = map(.x = samples, ~group_by(.x, Phylum) %>%
                               mutate(rel_abun_phylum = sum(rel_abun_ASV)) %>%
                              ungroup()))


```

# Quality control {.tabset}

Controls are retained in these plots. Mapped reads are expressed as a percentage
of the total reads recorded for the corresponding barcode.

### Number of ASVs

```{r number-of-asvs}
merged_alpha_div %>% 
   ggplot(
    aes(x = SampleID, y = uniqueOTUs)
  ) + geom_col(fill = "#39789c", width = 0.75) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Observed ASVs") + 
  coord_flip()
```

### Number of Reads

```{r number-of-reads}
merged_alpha_div %>% 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = SampleID, y = Reads)
  ) + 
    geom_col(fill = "#39789c", width = 0.75) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mapped reads") +
  coord_flip()

```

### Mapped reads 

```{r mapped-reads}
merged_alpha_div %>% 
  mutate(p = if_else(total_reads > 0, Reads / total_reads * 100, NA_real_)) %>% 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = SampleID, y = p, fill = SampleSite )
  ) + 
      geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mapped reads (%)", fill = "Plant") + 
  coord_flip()
```

```{r rarefaction-curve, fig.width=13, fig.height=9, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
amp_rarecurve(d_ASV_V4, color_by = "SampleID", stepsize = 1000) 

```

```{r}

# Harmonise names such as g__Ca._Amarolinea and Ca Amarolinea.
clean_genus <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("^[a-z]__") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_replace(regex("^Ca\\.?\\s+", ignore_case = TRUE), "Ca ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_to_lower()
}

taxon_label <- function(taxon, parent, rank) {

  # Format one label at a time.
  if (is.na(taxon) || !nzchar(taxon)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  clean_text <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return("")

    x <- stringr::str_remove(x, "^[a-z]__")

    # Remove the primer marker.
    x <- stringr::str_remove_all(
      x,
      stringr::regex("V1V3[ _-]*", ignore_case = TRUE)
    )

    # Rename Zotu identifiers, including those preceded by "_".
    x <- stringr::str_replace_all(
      x,
      stringr::regex(
        "(?<![[:alnum:]])Zotu[ _-]*(\\d+)",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      ),
      "ASV\\1"
    )

    # Preserve underscores in taxonomic names.
    stringr::str_squish(x)
  }

  format_name <- function(x) {
    if (!nzchar(x)) return("")

    # Separate a terminal ASV identifier from the taxonomic name.
    asv_pattern <- "(?<![[:alnum:]])ASV\\d+$"
    asv <- stringr::str_extract(x, asv_pattern)

    name <- stringr::str_remove(x, asv_pattern)
    name <- stringr::str_remove(name, "[ _-]+$")
    name <- stringr::str_trim(name)

    # Recognise unclassified labels separated by spaces or underscores.
    unclassified_pattern <- stringr::regex(
      "^unclassified(?:[ _]+|$)",
      ignore_case = TRUE
    )

    unclassified <- stringr::str_detect(
      name, unclassified_pattern
    )

    heading <- ""

    if (unclassified) {
      name <- stringr::str_remove(
        name, unclassified_pattern
      )

      rank_pattern <- "^([dkpcofgs])(?:[ _]+|$)"
      rank_code <- stringr::str_match(
        name, rank_pattern
      )[, 2]

      if (!is.na(rank_code)) {
        name <- stringr::str_remove(name, rank_pattern)
      } else {
        rank_code <- switch(
          tolower(rank),
          domain = "d",
          kingdom = "k",
          phylum = "p",
          class = "c",
          order = "o",
          family = "f",
          genus = "g",
          species = "s",
          NA_character_
        )
      }

      heading <- if (!is.na(rank_code)) {
        paste0("Unclas. (", rank_code, ")")
      } else {
        "Unclas."
      }
    }

    # Same pattern for detection AND replacement.
    # Matches Ca._Name, Ca. Name, Ca_Name and Ca Name.
    ca_pattern <- "^Ca\\.?[ _]+"

    if (stringr::str_detect(name, ca_pattern)) {
      name <- stringr::str_replace(
        name,
        ca_pattern,
        "*Ca.* "
      )

    } else if (
      nzchar(name) &&
      !stringr::str_detect(
        name,
        stringr::regex("midas", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) &&
      !unclassified
    ) {
      # Italicise ordinary classified names.
      name <- paste0("*", name, "*")
    }

    parts <- c(heading, name, asv)
    paste(parts[!is.na(parts) & nzchar(parts)], collapse = " ")
  }
  
    clean <- clean_text(taxon)
    parent_clean <- clean_text(parent)
  
    is_unclassified <- stringr::str_detect(
      clean,
      stringr::regex(
        "^unclassified(?:[ _]+|$)",
        ignore_case = TRUE
      )
    )
  
    # Add parent information only for classified midas taxa.
    if (
      !is_unclassified &&
      stringr::str_detect(
        clean,
        stringr::regex("midas", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) &&
      nzchar(parent_clean)
    ) {
      return(paste0(
        format_name(parent_clean),
        "; ",
        format_name(clean)
      ))
    }
  
    format_name(clean)
  }


# Also requires ggtext and ggh4x.

build_manure_heatmaps <- function(
    long_data,
    top_bacteria = 10,
    top_archaea = 7,
    cell_label_min = 0.01,
    domain_col = "Kingdom",
    function_data = midas_functions,
    function_names = function_labels
) {

  # Sample metadata ---------------------------------------------------------
  meta <- long_data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      SampleID,
      Experiment = as.character(Experiment),
      ManureID = as.character(ManureID),
      Comment = as.character(Comment)
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  if (anyDuplicated(meta$SampleID)) {
    stop("Each SampleID must have one metadata row.")
  }

  if (anyNA(meta)) {
    stop("SampleID, Experiment, ManureID and Comment must not contain NA.")
  }

  if (!all(meta$Comment %in% c("Start", "End"))) {
    stop("Comment must contain only 'Start' and 'End'.")
  }

  # Retain the original manure order within each experiment.
  manure_order <- long_data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(Experiment, ManureID, treatment) %>%
    arrange(Experiment, as.numeric(as.character(treatment))) %>%
    pull(ManureID) %>%
    unique()
  
  

  meta <- meta %>%
    mutate(
      Experiment = factor(Experiment, levels = sort(unique(Experiment))),
      ManureID = factor(ManureID, levels = manure_order),
      Comment = factor(Comment, levels = c("Start", "End"))
    )

  nested <- long_data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(SampleID, samples) %>%
    unnest(samples)

  required <- c(domain_col, "Genus", "Family", "rel_abun_genus")

  if (!all(required %in% names(nested))) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns inside samples: ",
      paste(setdiff(required, names(nested)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Genus abundances can be repeated across species rows.
  # Remove identical copies rather than summing them.
  abundance <- nested %>%
    transmute(
      SampleID,
      Domain = sub("^[a-z]__", "", as.character(.data[[domain_col]])),
      Parent = coalesce(as.character(Family), ""),
      Taxon = as.character(Genus),
      Abundance = rel_abun_genus
    ) %>%
    filter(Domain %in% c("Bacteria", "Archaea")) %>%
    mutate(
      Taxon = if_else(
        is.na(Taxon) | trimws(Taxon) == "",
        paste0(
          "Unclassified f ",
          if_else(Parent == "", "unknown family", sub("^[a-z]__", "", Parent))
        ),
        Taxon
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct()

  if (!is.numeric(abundance$Abundance) ||
      anyNA(abundance$Abundance) ||
      any(!is.finite(abundance$Abundance)) ||
      any(abundance$Abundance < 0)) {
    stop("rel_abun_genus must contain finite, non-negative numeric abundances.")
  }

  conflicts <- abundance %>%
    count(SampleID, Domain, Taxon, Parent) %>%
    filter(n > 1)

  if (nrow(conflicts) > 0) {
    stop("Conflicting genus abundances found within a sample.")
  }

  # Give each taxon/parent combination a unique plotting key.
  taxonomy <- abundance %>%
    distinct(Domain, Taxon, Parent) %>%
    mutate(TaxonKey = paste0("taxon_", row_number()))

  abundance <- abundance %>%
    left_join(taxonomy, by = c("Domain", "Taxon", "Parent"))

  # Include explicit zeros for taxa absent from a sample.
  complete_data <- crossing(
    SampleID = meta$SampleID,
    TaxonKey = taxonomy$TaxonKey
  ) %>%
    left_join(
      abundance %>% select(SampleID, TaxonKey, Abundance),
      by = c("SampleID", "TaxonKey")
    ) %>%
    mutate(Abundance = replace_na(Abundance, 0)) %>%
    left_join(taxonomy, by = "TaxonKey") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "SampleID")

  # Shared abundance scale -------------------------------------------------
  bin_levels <- c(
    "0", "<0.01", "0.01–<0.1", "0.1–<1",
    "1–<2", "2–<5", "≥5"
  )

  bin_colours <- setNames(
    c(
      "#E8E8E8", "#FFFFFF", "#FFF5EB", "#F5C9B0",
      "#EC9E75", "#E2733B", "#B63600"
    ),
    bin_levels
  )


  make_heatmap <- function(domain, n_top) {

  domain_data <- complete_data %>%
    filter(Domain == domain)

  if (nrow(domain_data) == 0) {
    stop("No taxa found for domain: ", domain)
  }

  # Average replicates within each timepoint first.
  sample_means <- domain_data %>%
    group_by(Experiment, ManureID, Comment, TaxonKey) %>%
    summarise(
      Abundance = mean(Abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Select top taxa separately for each manure,
  # based on mean abundance across Start and End.
  top <- sample_means %>%
    group_by(Experiment, ManureID, TaxonKey, Comment) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_abundance = mean(Abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(Mean_abundance > 0) %>%
    arrange(Experiment, ManureID, Comment, desc(Mean_abundance), TaxonKey) %>%
    group_by(Experiment, ManureID, Comment) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    ungroup()

  selected <- unique(top$TaxonKey)

  # Sort displayed taxa by overall mean abundance.
  # The most abundant taxon appears at the top.
  taxa_order <- sample_means %>%
    filter(TaxonKey %in% selected) %>%
    group_by(TaxonKey) %>%
    summarise(
      Overall_abundance = mean(Abundance),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Overall_abundance), TaxonKey) %>%
    pull(TaxonKey)

  tax_labels <- taxonomy %>%
    filter(TaxonKey %in% selected) %>%
    mutate(
      TaxonLabel = map2_chr(
        Taxon, Parent,
        ~ taxon_label(.x, .y, rank = "Genus")
      )
    )

  # Black outlines indicate the top taxa within each manure.
  display <- sample_means %>%
    filter(TaxonKey %in% selected) %>%
    left_join(
      top %>%
        select(Experiment, ManureID, TaxonKey, Comment) %>%
        mutate(Top = TRUE),
      by = c("Experiment", "ManureID", "TaxonKey", "Comment")
    ) %>%
    mutate(Top = replace_na(Top, FALSE))

  # Remaining abundance excludes ALL taxa displayed in the heatmap.
  # remaining <- sample_means %>%
  #   group_by(Experiment, ManureID, Comment) %>%
  #   summarise(
  #     Abundance = sum(Abundance[!TaxonKey %in% selected]),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   ) %>%
  #   mutate(
  #     TaxonKey = "__remaining__",
  #     Top = FALSE
  #   )
  
  remaining <- sample_means %>%
  group_by(Experiment, ManureID, Comment) %>%
  summarise(
    N_remaining = sum(
      !TaxonKey %in% selected & Abundance > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Abundance = sum(
      Abundance[!TaxonKey %in% selected],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TaxonKey = "__remaining__",
    Top = FALSE
  )

  
  display <- bind_rows(display, remaining) %>%
    mutate(
      TaxonKey = factor(
        TaxonKey,
        levels = c("__remaining__", rev(taxa_order))
      ),
      Bin = case_when(
        Abundance == 0   ~ "0",
        Abundance < 0.01 ~ "<0.01",
        Abundance < 0.1  ~ "0.01–<0.1",
        Abundance < 1    ~ "0.1–<1",
        Abundance < 2    ~ "1–<2",
        Abundance < 5    ~ "2–<5",
        TRUE             ~ "≥5"
      ),
      Bin = factor(Bin, levels = bin_levels),
      #Value_label = if_else(
      #  Abundance >= cell_label_min,
      #  sprintf("%.1f", Abundance),
      #  ""
      #),
      Value_label = case_when(
        TaxonKey == "__remaining__" ~ sprintf(
          "%.0f (%d)", Abundance, N_remaining
        ),
        Abundance >= cell_label_min ~ sprintf("%.1f", Abundance),
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      Text_colour = if_else(Abundance >= 5, "white", "black")
    )

  labels <- c(
    setNames(tax_labels$TaxonLabel, tax_labels$TaxonKey),
    "__remaining__" = paste("Remaining", tolower(domain))
  )

  p <- ggplot(display, aes(Comment, TaxonKey)) +
    geom_tile(
      aes(fill = Bin),
      colour = "grey90",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_tile(
      data = filter(display, Top),
      fill = NA,
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.45
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = Value_label, colour = Text_colour),
      size = 2.7
    ) +
    ggh4x::facet_nested(
      cols = vars(Experiment, ManureID),
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x"
    ) +
    scale_colour_identity() +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = bin_colours,
      drop = FALSE,
      name = "Relative abundance (%)"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      labels = labels,
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(domain, " — Genus"),
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggtext::element_markdown(
        size = 9,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        #angle = 45,
        #hjust = 1,
        size = 9,
        colour = "black"
      ),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = "grey60",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  
  # Functional annotations for exactly the displayed taxa --------------------
row_levels <- levels(display$TaxonKey)

annotation_taxa <- taxonomy %>%
  filter(TaxonKey %in% selected) %>%
  transmute(
    TaxonKey,
    Domain,
    GenusKey = clean_genus(Taxon)
  )
```

```{r}

plot_manure_functions <- function(heatmaps, assignments,
                                 bacteria_columns = c('Polysaccharide hydrolysis', 'Sugar fermentation',
                                   'Peptide/AA catabolism', 'VFA production',
                                   'H2/formate production', 'Lactate production'),
                                 archaea_columns = c('CO2-reducing methanogenesis',
                                   'Acetoclastic methanogenesis',
                                   'Methyl dismutation methanogenesis',
                                   'H2-dependent methyl methanogenesis'),
                                 point_size = 2.8, function_width = 0.8) {
  
  
 
  
  key <- function(x) stringr::str_to_lower(stringr::str_squish(
    stringr::str_replace_all(stringr::str_remove(x, '^[a-z]__'), '_', ' ')))
  required <- c('Taxon','Function','Status','Evidence')
  stopifnot(all(required %in% names(assignments)))
  assignments <- assignments |> dplyr::mutate(JoinKey = key(Taxon))
  if (anyDuplicated(assignments[c('JoinKey','Function')]))
    stop('Resolve duplicate taxon/function assignments first.')
  
   allowed_status <- c("pos", "neg", "variable", "unknown")

  if (!all(assignments$Status %in% allowed_status)) {
    stop("Status must be pos, neg, variable or unknown.")
  }
  
  # if (!all(assignments$Status %in% c('pos','neg','unknown')))
  #   stop('Status must be pos, neg or unknown.')
  make_panel <- function(result, columns) {
    levels_y <- levels(result$data$TaxonKey)
    if (is.null(levels_y)) stop('Expected factor TaxonKey in result$data.')
    taxa <- result$top_taxa |> dplyr::distinct(TaxonKey, Taxon) |>
      dplyr::mutate(TaxonKey = as.character(TaxonKey), JoinKey = key(Taxon),
        Excluded = stringr::str_detect(Taxon,
          stringr::regex('midas|unclas', ignore_case = TRUE)))
    if (anyDuplicated(taxa$TaxonKey)) stop('TaxonKey has conflicting names.')
    points <- tidyr::crossing(
        TaxonKey = levels_y,
        Function = columns
      ) |>
        dplyr::left_join(taxa, by = "TaxonKey") |>
        dplyr::left_join(
          assignments |> dplyr::select(-Taxon),
          by = c("JoinKey", "Function")
        ) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          Remaining = TaxonKey == "__remaining__",
      
          # Unclassified/MiDAS taxa receive explicit unknown open points.
          Excluded = dplyr::coalesce(Excluded, FALSE),
      
          Status = dplyr::case_when(
            Excluded ~ "unknown",
            TRUE ~ dplyr::coalesce(Status, "unknown")
          ),
      
          Evidence = dplyr::case_when(
            Excluded | Status == "unknown" ~ "None",
            TRUE ~ dplyr::coalesce(Evidence, "None")
          ),
      
          TaxonKey = factor(TaxonKey, levels = levels_y),
          Function = factor(Function, levels = columns)
        )
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot(points, ggplot2::aes(Function, TaxonKey)) +
        ggplot2::geom_point(
          data = dplyr::filter(points, !Remaining),
          ggplot2::aes(
            colour = Status,
            shape = Evidence
          ),
          size = point_size,
          stroke = 0.7
        )   +
      #ggplot2::aes(colour = Status, shape = Evidence), size = point_size) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
          name = "Reported capability",
          values = c(
            pos      = "#238B65",
            neg      = "#CB4545",
            variable = "#E6B800",
            unknown  = "#BDBDBD"
          ),
          limits = allowed_status,
          labels = c(
            "Positive",
            "Negative in tested representatives",
            "Variable among species/strains",
            "Unknown"
          ),
          drop = FALSE
        ) +
      ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(Experimental = 16, Genomic = 17,
        Both = 15, None = 1), limits = c('Experimental','Genomic','Both','None'),
        labels = c('Experimental','Genomic prediction','Experimental + genomic','No evidence'),
        drop = FALSE, name = 'Evidence') +
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(position = 'top', drop = FALSE,
        labels = function(x) dplyr::recode(x,
          'Peptide/AA catabolism' = 'Peptides / AA',
          'H2/formate production' = 'H2 / formate production',
          'Methyl dismutation methanogenesis' = 'Methyl dismutation',
          'H2-dependent methyl methanogenesis' = 'H2-dependent methyl reduction')) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(
          limits = levels_y,
          drop = FALSE,
          expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.5)
        )  +
      ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = 'grey93', linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(), axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "transparent", fill = "transparent"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8)),
        strip.clip = "off",
        axis.text.x.top = element_blank(), #ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = 'bottom') +
      ggplot2::facet_grid(
  cols = ggplot2::vars(Function),
  scales = "free_x",
  space = "free_x",
  drop = TRUE
) +  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(
  drop = TRUE,
  expand = ggplot2::expansion(add = 0.1)
)
    list(plot = p, data = points)
  }
 
  
   # Keep one abundance legend and one set of functional legends.
  # Build the functional point panels.
  b <- make_panel(heatmaps$bacteria, bacteria_columns)
  a <- make_panel(heatmaps$archaea, archaea_columns)

  # Retain one abundance legend.
  b_abundance <- heatmaps$bacteria$abundance_plot +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  a_abundance <- heatmaps$archaea$abundance_plot +
    ggplot2::guides(fill = "none", colour = "none")

  # Retain one set of functional legends.
  b_functions <- b$plot +
    ggplot2::guides(
      colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        order = 2,
        override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3)
      ),
      shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        order = 3,
        override.aes = list(colour = "grey30", size = 3)
      )
    )

  a_functions <- a$plot +
    ggplot2::guides(colour = "none", shape = "none")

  combined_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    b_abundance,
    b_functions,
    a_abundance,
    a_functions,
    ncol = 2,
    heights = c(
      heatmaps$bacteria$n_rows,
      heatmaps$archaea$n_rows
    ),
    widths = c(
      22,
      function_width *
        max(length(bacteria_columns), length(archaea_columns))
    ),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    )
  
  combined_plot_HM_only <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
    b_abundance,
    a_abundance,
    ncol = 1,
    heights = c(
      heatmaps$bacteria$n_rows,
      heatmaps$archaea$n_rows
    ),
    widths = c(
      16,
      function_width *
        max(length(bacteria_columns), length(archaea_columns))
    ),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    )

  
  list(
    plot = combined_plot,
    plot2 = combined_plot_HM_only,
    bacteria = b,
    archaea = a
  )
}
```

## Figure XX: Ordination 

```{r pca-function, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

amp_pca_taxa <- function(
    data,
    tax_aggregate = "Genus",
    sample_color_by,
    sample_label_by = NULL,
    trajectory_order = c("Start", "End"),
    trajectory_group = c("Start", "End"),
    filter_taxa = 0.1,
    n_loadings = 25,
    sample_point_size = 2.5,
    loading_point_size = 1,
    loading_label_size = 3,
    loading_scale = 0.8,
    detailed_output = FALSE
) {

  taxonomic_ranks <- c(
    "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order",
    "Family", "Genus", "Species"
  )

  if (!tax_aggregate %in% taxonomic_ranks) {
    stop(
      "tax_aggregate must be one of: ",
      paste(taxonomic_ranks, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  abund <- as.matrix(data$abund)
  storage.mode(abund) <- "double"

  tax <- as.data.frame(data$tax)
  metadata <- as.data.frame(data$metadata)

  otu_ids <- rownames(abund)
  sample_ids <- colnames(abund)

  # Match taxonomy with abundance table
  if (all(otu_ids %in% rownames(tax))) {

    tax <- tax[otu_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  } else if ("OTU" %in% colnames(tax)) {

    if (!all(otu_ids %in% tax$OTU)) {
      stop("Some ASVs are missing from the taxonomy table.")
    }
    tax <- tax[match(otu_ids, tax$OTU), , drop = FALSE]

  } else {

    stop("Could not match taxonomy to the abundance table.")
  }

  # Extract selected taxonomic level
  taxon <- as.character(tax[[tax_aggregate]])

  missing_taxon <- is.na(taxon) | trimws(taxon) == ""

  target_position <- match(
    tax_aggregate,
    taxonomic_ranks
  )

  # Find the lowest available rank above the selected level
  if (target_position > 1) {

    higher_ranks <- tax[
      ,
      taxonomic_ranks[seq_len(target_position - 1)],
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    higher_ranks[] <- lapply(
      higher_ranks,
      function(x) {
        x <- as.character(x)
        x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- NA_character_
        x
      }
    )

    latest_classification <- apply(
      higher_ranks,
      1,
      function(x) {
        classified <- x[!is.na(x)]

        if (length(classified) == 0) {
          "unknown"
        } else {
          tail(classified, 1)
        }
      }
    )

  } else {

    latest_classification <- rep(
      "unknown",
      nrow(tax)
    )
  }

  # Remove prefixes such as f_ or f__
  latest_classification <- sub(
    "^[a-z]__?",
    "",
    latest_classification
  )

  # Unique name for each unclassified taxon
  taxon[missing_taxon] <- paste0(
    "unclassified_",
    tolower(tax_aggregate),
    "_",
    latest_classification[missing_taxon],
    "_",
    otu_ids[missing_taxon]
  )

  # Aggregate abundance table
  taxon_abund <- rowsum(
    abund,
    group = taxon,
    reorder = FALSE,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (any(colSums(taxon_abund) <= 0)) {
    stop("One or more input samples have no reads.")
  }

  # Calculate relative abundance
  taxon_relative <- sweep(
    taxon_abund,
    2,
    colSums(taxon_abund),
    "/"
  ) * 100

  maximum_abundance <- apply(
    taxon_relative,
    1,
    max,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  keep_taxa <- maximum_abundance > filter_taxa

  message(
    sum(!keep_taxa), " ", tolower(tax_aggregate),
    " taxa filtered; ",
    sum(keep_taxa), " retained."
  )

  taxon_abund <- taxon_abund[
    keep_taxa,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(taxon_abund) < 2) {
    stop("Fewer than two taxa remain after filtering.")
  }

  # Samples × taxa
  community <- t(taxon_abund)

  empty_samples <- rowSums(community) == 0

  if (any(empty_samples)) {
    stop(
      "Samples empty after filtering: ",
      paste(rownames(community)[empty_samples], collapse = ", "),
      ". Reduce filter_taxa."
    )
  }

  # Hellinger transformation
  community_hellinger <- sqrt(
    sweep(
      community,
      1,
      rowSums(community),
      "/"
    )
  )

  # Remove taxa without variation
  taxon_variance <- apply(
    community_hellinger,
    2,
    var
  )

  keep_variable <- is.finite(taxon_variance) &
    taxon_variance > 0

  community_hellinger <- community_hellinger[
    ,
    keep_variable,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (ncol(community_hellinger) < 2) {
    stop("Fewer than two variable taxa remain.")
  }

  if (nrow(community_hellinger) < 3) {
    stop("At least three samples are needed for the two-axis PCA plot.")
  }

  # PCA
  pca <- prcomp(
    community_hellinger,
    center = TRUE,
    scale. = FALSE
  )

  explained_variance <- 100 * pca$sdev^2 /
    sum(pca$sdev^2)

  sample_scores <- data.frame(
    SampleID = rownames(pca$x),
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2],
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  loading_scores <- data.frame(
    Taxon = rownames(pca$rotation),
    PC1 = pca$rotation[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$rotation[, 2],
    check.names = FALSE
  )
 
#   loading_scores$importance <-
#     loading_scores$PC1^2 +
#     loading_scores$PC2^2

  rotation_2d <- pca$rotation[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]

  loading_scores$importance <- rowSums(
    sweep(
      rotation_2d^2,
      2,
      pca$sdev[1:2]^2,
      "*"
    )
  )
  
  loading_scores$Label <- sub(
    "^[a-z]__?",
    "",
    loading_scores$Taxon
  )

  # Scale loadings into sample-score space
  x_scale <- max(abs(sample_scores$PC1)) /
    max(abs(loading_scores$PC1))

  y_scale <- max(abs(sample_scores$PC2)) /
    max(abs(loading_scores$PC2))

  scale_factor <- min(x_scale, y_scale) *
    loading_scale

  loading_scores$PC1 <-
    loading_scores$PC1 * scale_factor

  loading_scores$PC2 <-
    loading_scores$PC2 * scale_factor

  loading_scores <- loading_scores[
    order(
      loading_scores$importance,
      decreasing = TRUE
    ),
  ]

  labelled_loadings <- head(
    loading_scores,
    n_loadings
  )

  # Match metadata
  if (all(sample_ids %in% rownames(metadata))) {

    metadata <- metadata[sample_ids, , drop = FALSE]

  } else {

    possible_id_columns <- colnames(metadata)[
      vapply(
        metadata,
        function(x) {
          all(sample_ids %in% as.character(x))
        },
        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (length(possible_id_columns) == 0) {
      stop("Could not match metadata to samples.")
    }

    metadata <- metadata[
      match(
        sample_ids,
        as.character(metadata[[possible_id_columns[1]]])
      ),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  }

  metadata_scores <- metadata[
    match(sample_scores$SampleID, sample_ids),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  

  # Remove duplicate columns, including SampleID
  metadata_scores <- metadata_scores[
    ,
    !colnames(metadata_scores) %in%
      colnames(sample_scores),
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  sample_scores <- cbind(
    sample_scores,
    metadata_scores
  )

  # Base plot
  p <- ggplot(
    sample_scores,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      colour = .data[[sample_color_by]]
    )
  )

  # Trajectories
  if (!is.null(trajectory_order)) {

    if (is.null(trajectory_group)) {
      trajectory_group <- sample_color_by
    }

    trajectory_data <- sample_scores[
      order(
        sample_scores[[trajectory_group]],
        sample_scores[[trajectory_order]], decreasing = T
      ),
    ]

    p <- p +
      geom_path(
        data = trajectory_data,
        aes(group = .data[[trajectory_group]]),
        linewidth = 0.7,
        alpha = 1, 
        arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(3, "mm"), type = "closed")
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_point(size = sample_point_size) +

    geom_point(
      data = loading_scores,
      aes(x = PC1, y = PC2),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "grey40",
      size = loading_point_size
    ) +

    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = labelled_loadings,
      aes(
        x = PC1,
        y = PC2,
        label = Label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      size = loading_label_size,
      fontface = "italic",
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      seed = 1
    )

  if (!is.null(sample_label_by)) {

    p <- p +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        aes(label = .data[[sample_label_by]]),
        colour = "black",
        size = 3.5,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        seed = 1,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    labs(
      x = paste0(
        "PC1 [",
        round(explained_variance[1], 1),
        "%]"
      ),
      y = paste0(
        "PC2 [",
        round(explained_variance[2], 1),
        "%]"
      ),
      colour = sample_color_by
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(colour = "Manure ID") +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )

  if (detailed_output) {
    return(
      list(
        plot = p,
        pca = pca,
        sample_scores = sample_scores,
        taxon_loadings = loading_scores,
        taxon_abundance = taxon_abund,
        hellinger = community_hellinger
      )
    )
  }

  p
}
```

```{r pca-panel-helper, include=FALSE}
pca_panels <- function(data, rank = "Genus") {
  draw_panel <- function(input, title) {
    amp_pca_taxa(
      data = input,
      tax_aggregate = rank,
      sample_color_by = "ManureID",
      sample_label_by = "Comment",
      trajectory_order = "Comment",
      trajectory_group = "ManureID",
      filter_taxa = 0.1,
      n_loadings = 15
    ) + labs(title = title, colour = "ManureID")
  }

  #p_all <- draw_panel(data, "All samples")
  p_bovaer <- draw_panel(
    amp_subset_samples(data, Experiment == "Experiment 1"), "Experiment 1"
  )
  p_silvaer <- draw_panel(
    amp_subset_samples(data, Experiment == "Experiment 2"), "Experiment 2"
  )

  ((p_bovaer | p_silvaer)) 
  # +
  #   plot_annotation(title = paste(rank, "composition — Hellinger PCA"))
}


pca_panels_2 <- function(data, rank = "Genus") {
  draw_panel <- function(input, title) {
    amp_pca_taxa(
      data = input,
      tax_aggregate = rank,
      sample_color_by = "SampleSite_Tank",
      sample_label_by = "Data_chr",
      trajectory_order = "Comment",
      trajectory_group = "SampleSite_Tank",
      filter_taxa = 0.1,
      n_loadings = 25
    ) + labs(title = title, colour = "Plant / tank")
  }

  p_all <- draw_panel(data, "All samples")
  p_bovaer <- draw_panel(
    amp_subset_samples(data, type == "Bovaer"), "Bovaer"
  )
  p_silvaer <- draw_panel(
    amp_subset_samples(data, type == "Silvaer"), "Silvaer"
  )

  (p_all / (p_bovaer | p_silvaer)) +
    plot_annotation(title = paste(rank, "composition — Hellinger PCA"))
}
```

```{r}
format_gps <- function(latitude, longitude) {
  # Determine N/S and E/W
  lat_direction <- ifelse(latitude >= 0, "N", "S")
  lon_direction <- ifelse(longitude >= 0, "E", "W")
  
  # Absolute values to remove negative sign
  abs_latitude <- abs(latitude)
  abs_longitude <- abs(longitude)
  
  # Format with 4 decimal places
  formatted_latitude <- sprintf("%.4f", abs_latitude)
  formatted_longitude <- sprintf("%.4f", abs_longitude)
  
  # Create the formatted string
  formatted_coords <- paste0(formatted_latitude, " ", lat_direction, " ", formatted_longitude, " ", lon_direction)
  
  return(formatted_coords)
}


metadata_ncbi <- included_samples %>%
  transmute(
    sample_name = paste(
      FlowcellID, Barcode, ManureID, SampleContent, SampleSite, 
      sep = "_"
    ),
    sample_title = paste0(
      "Cow manure microbial community from ",
      SampleSite,
      " during a manure storage experiment"
    ),
    bioproject_accession = NA_character_, # Add PRJNA accession when available
    organism = "manure metagenome",
    collection_date = format(Date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    # Adjust these two descriptions to the actual sampling setting
    env_broad_scale = "research facility [ENVO:00000469]",
    env_local_scale = "research facility [ENVO:00000469]",
    env_medium = "animal manure [ENVO:00003031]",
    geo_loc_name = if_else(
      is.na(SampleSite) | trimws(SampleSite) == "",
      "Denmark",
      paste0("Denmark: ", trimws(SampleSite), "; Tank: ", Tank)
    ),
    lat_lon = format_gps(longitude = Longitude, latitude =  Latitude),
    storage_system = "pilot-scale manure storage tank",
    isolation_source = "cow manure",
    storage_timepoint = Comment,
    # Optional custom attributes
    host = "Bos taurus (TAXID: 9913)",
    description = paste0(
      "Cow manure sample collected during a manure storage experiment. ",
      "Sample designation: ", SampleContent, "."
    ), 
    Barcode = Barcode, FlowcellID = FlowcellID
  )


metadata_ncbi_final <- 
  metadata_ncbi %>% 
  select(sample_name, sample_title, bioproject_accession, 
         organism, collection_date, 
         env_broad_scale, env_local_scale, env_medium, 
         geo_loc_name, lat_lon,
         storage_system, isolation_source, storage_timepoint, host,
         description, Barcode#, library_ID
)
```
